newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Ansett Australia increases flights to Indonesia.
newsitem.headline: Ansett Australia increases flights to Indonesia.

text.p: Ansett Australia plans next month to increase the number of flights between Australia, Indonesia and Malaysia by five flights a week from October 27, an official said on Tuesday.

Ron Brown, Ansett's manager Indonesia, said the schedule included the airline's first non-stop flights between Jakarta and Melbourne. Ansett currently flies Sydney-Jakarta-Kuala Lumpur four times each way weekly.
There was also additional flights between Sydney, Jakarta and Kuala Lumpur as well as Denpasar on the Indonesian holiday isle of Bali and Darwin in northern Australia, he said.
"The new services will have innovative freight opportunities," Brown told Reuters.
He said the Ansett was planning direct services between Jakarta and Brisbane and Perth in Australia by March next year.
